planSteps.description: Navigate to /?today=2026-10-19&fresh=1 (pins today to 2026-10-19 and clears saved trips in storage key ninety.trips.v1)
Enter 90 in the EES days used field (data-testid=ees-days-used) and click compare (data-testid=ees-compare)
The figure gap (data-testid=ees-figure-gap) says the counts are 26 days apart and the EES counts more
The findings list (data-testid=ees-codes) shows the text 'Days-used figures differ'
